texts.name: Stina
texts.biography: Stina, who has always lived in Burton, is willing to cooperate with anyone for survival. This girl is incredibly brave; it is said she dared to face over a dozen raiders alone in the desert and repel them.

specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Mechanics or Engineers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Mechanics
